typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		CPTY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		FEE_TYPE as string,
		FEE_DATE as timestamp,
		AMOUNT as double,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		FEE_ROLE as string,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		BOOK as string,
		PROCESSING_ORG as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> qry1a	source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupMarketerAULKPTABLE	source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupRevenueCenterAULKPTABLE	source(output(
		FEE_TYPE as string,
		COMMENTS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> qry2aLKPTABLE	source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		SHORT_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> qry3aLKPTABLE
qry1a,qry2aLKPTABLE lookup(qry1a@FEE_TYPE == qry2aLKPTABLE@FEE_TYPE,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> qry2a
qry2a select(mapColumn(
		TRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID,
		CPTY_ID = CPTY_ID,
		FEE_TYPE = qry2aLKPTABLE@FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		AMOUNT = AMOUNT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		FEE_ROLE = FEE_ROLE,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		PROCESSING_ORG = PROCESSING_ORG,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		COMMENTS = COMMENTS
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> qry2a01
qry2a01 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> qry2aIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
qry2aIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS = COMMENTS,
		TRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID,
		CPTY_ID = CPTY_ID,
		FEE_TYPE = FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		AMOUNT = AMOUNT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		FEE_ROLE = FEE_ROLE,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		PROCESSING_ORG = PROCESSING_ORG,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> qry2a0
qry2a0,qry2aIsMatch@NotMatch union(byName: true) ~> Combine2a
Combine2a,qry3aLKPTABLE lookup(toInteger(Combine2a@LEGAL_ENTITY_ID) == qry3aLKPTABLE@LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> qry3a
qry3a select(mapColumn(
		TRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID,
		CPTY_ID = CPTY_ID,
		FEE_TYPE = FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		AMOUNT = AMOUNT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = Combine2a@LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		FEE_ROLE = FEE_ROLE,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		PROCESSING_ORG = PROCESSING_ORG,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS = FEE_DEF_COMMENTS,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> qry3a01
qry3a01 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> qry3aIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
qry3aIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY = SHORT_NAME,
		TRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID,
		CPTY_ID = CPTY_ID,
		FEE_TYPE = FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		AMOUNT = AMOUNT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		FEE_ROLE = FEE_ROLE,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		PROCESSING_ORG = PROCESSING_ORG,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS = FEE_DEF_COMMENTS
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> qry3a0
qry3a0 derive(SHORT_NAME = FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY) ~> qry3a0ONETOMANY
Combine3a split(FEE_ROLE == 'Marketer', disjoint: true) ~> FeeRole4a@(Marketer,RevenueCenter)
FeeRole4a@Marketer,LookupMarketerAULKPTABLE lookup(FeeRole4a@Marketer@LEGAL_ENTITY_ID == LookupMarketerAULKPTABLE@LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupMarketerAU
FeeRole4a@RevenueCenter,LookupRevenueCenterAULKPTABLE lookup(FeeRole4a@RevenueCenter@LEGAL_ENTITY_ID == LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupRevenueCenterAU
LookupMarketerAU select(mapColumn(
		FEE_ROLE = FEE_ROLE,
		TRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID,
		CPTY_ID = CPTY_ID,
		FEE_TYPE = FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		AMOUNT = AMOUNT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = LookupMarketerAULKPTABLE@LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		PROCESSING_ORG = PROCESSING_ORG,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS = FEE_DEF_COMMENTS,
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY = FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupMarketerAU01
LookupRevenueCenterAU split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupRevenueCenterAUIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupMarketerAU01 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupMarketerAUIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupRevenueCenterAUIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY_AU = ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,
		FEE_ROLE = FEE_ROLE,
		TRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID,
		CPTY_ID = CPTY_ID,
		FEE_TYPE = FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		AMOUNT = AMOUNT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		PROCESSING_ORG = PROCESSING_ORG,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS = FEE_DEF_COMMENTS,
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY = FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupRevenueCenterAU0
LookupMarketerAUIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY_AU = ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,
		FEE_ROLE = FEE_ROLE,
		TRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID,
		CPTY_ID = CPTY_ID,
		FEE_TYPE = FEE_TYPE,
		FEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		AMOUNT = AMOUNT,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		PROCESSING_ORG = PROCESSING_ORG,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS = FEE_DEF_COMMENTS,
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY = FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupMarketerAU0
LookupMarketerAU0,LookupRevenueCenterAU0,LookupMarketerAUIsMatch@NotMatch,LookupRevenueCenterAUIsMatch@NotMatch union(byName: true) ~> Combine4a
Combine4a derive(RUN_TIME = currentTimestamp()) ~> AddRunDateZa
AddRunDateZa sink(input(
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY as string,
		CPTY_ID as long,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as long,
		PRODUCT_ID as long,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		RUN_TIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FEE_ROLE as string,
		FEE_TYPE as string,
		AMOUNT as integer,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as long,
		BOOK as string,
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY_AU as string,
		TRADE_ID as long,
		FEE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROCESSING_ORG as string,
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY,
		CPTY_ID,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		PRODUCT_ID,
		TRADE_STATUS,
		RUN_TIME,
		FEE_ROLE,
		FEE_TYPE,
		AMOUNT,
		BOOK_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		BOOK,
		FEE_LEGAL_ENTITY_AU,
		TRADE_ID,
		FEE_DATE,
		PROCESSING_ORG,
		FEE_DEF_COMMENTS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
